query: What lifecycle, governance, and rollback procedures (model signing, versioning, audit logs, federated updates) are necessary for safe production rollout?

response.query: What lifecycle, governance, and rollback procedures (model signing, versioning, audit logs, federated updates) are necessary for safe production rollout?
response.answer: For safe production rollout, implement model signing, versioning, audit logs, and federated updates. Ensure rollback procedures are in place for quick recovery. Use comprehensive monitoring and logging for traceability.

results.title: Boomi Integration and Automation Platform Release - September 2025
results.content: Our September release for API Management delivers support for AI agent consumption of APIs via MCP, accelerated API implementation in Boomi Integration, discovery and federation of APIs from Apigee X, and OpenTelemetry in our API Gateway. The September release for Boomi AI introduces powerful new capabilities across Agentstudio and Platform AI Agents that enhance security, expand functionality, and streamline development. This connector will allow you to turn your Boomi processes into AI-ready tools that can be easily integrated into Boomi Agentstudio or used with third-party MCP clients like Claude. This lets you monitor your integrations at scale with native OpenTelemetry support for integration runtimes, and easily stream real time telemetry data including metrics, logs, and traces from your runtime and integration process executions to third-party monitoring tools like New Relic or DataDog for trending, alerting, and troubleshooting. ## Data Hub. This month’s release enhances the data discovery experience with flexible new search capabilities for Command Center, adds richer context to our connector operations, and delivers powerful new tools for advanced data stewardship and management.
